headline: Dangote Group Hires Técnicas Reunidas for $4 Billion Fertilizer Project
summary: Nigeria's Dangote Group has contracted Spanish engineering firm Técnicas Reunidas to supply two hydrogen reformers for its $4 billion fertilizer plant under construction in Gode, Ethiopia.
why: Cross-border engineering, procurement, and construction contracts drive substantial capital expenditures and international industrial collaboration in major emerging-market infrastructure projects.

impacts.name: Tecnicas Reunidas SA
impacts.why: Securing contracts for multi-billion-dollar industrial projects supports future engineering revenues.
